svg.title: What helps a person in should not need the help to turn on
svg.desc: Finding 12 · by reading · EN 301 549 5.2 · a menu to talk over, with what is not built yet said so A discussion mockup drawn by hand from the built-in theme's colours, not a screenshot.
svg.text: What helps a person in should not need the help to turn on
Finding 12 · by reading · EN 301 549 5.2 · a menu to talk over, with what is not built yet said so
A file, read at the size you cannot read
One menu, from a key and from four places
Making the desktop larger, stiller and plainer today
No action, no key and no row of a menu sets any of these
omorfosctl has no “set”; “Settings” says there are none yet
The welcome card offers a scheme and a wallpaper, and no more
Nothing on the lock screen, which a person meets every day
The file is read again as it is saved, which is the hard part done
The same, and what is still to come, in one place
Actions for each, so a key, a script and a menu can do it
Written through omorfos_config::edit, as the welcome card writes
The rows marked “to come” are the roadmap's own, with a place kept
The words are the ones other desktops use (finding 23)
The key, and whether it is a menu or a card, are to be chosen
